Rules.summaryTitle: Found EC2 instance that are not managed by SSM
Rules.Why does it matter?: SSM allows you to manage your EC2 instances centeally. A common use for SSM is to manage OS patching. If you are not using SSM to manage your EC2 instances, you may be missing out on a valuable tool.
Rules.How to fix: It is highly recommended that you use SSM to manage your EC2 instances. You can use SSM to manage OS patching, run commands, and even access the EC2 instance via a web-based shell.
